jyutping: jat1 bin1 sok3 bei6 jat1 bin1 gong2

english.note: Use this construction when someone says something while audibly sniffing because of illness, emotion, or contempt.

examples.english: They said, while they sniff, “I’m fine.”
examples.traditional: 佢一邊索鼻一邊講：「我冇事呀。」
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 bin1 sok3 bei6 jat1 bin1 gong2 ngo5 mou5 si6 aa3
